usage: The word 壁虎 refers to a small reptile known as a gecko.
As a noun, 壁虎 can be used to identify the animal itself or when talking about seeing one.
You can use 壁虎 to describe the animal in various situations, such as in nature or when found inside homes.
It is commonly used in everyday conversations in Hong Kong when people notice or talk about geckos.
壁虎 is singular and plural in form; it depends on the context whether one or many geckos are meant.
